    For its March 25, 2026, MLB Opening Night matchup between the Yankees and Giants,
    Netflix features play-by-play announcer Matt Vasgersian alongside analysts CC Sabathia and Hunter Pence. The studio team includes host Elle Duncan with Barry Bonds, Albert Pujols, and Anthony Rizzo, with Lauren Shehadi as reporter. 
    Announce Team (Yankees-Giants Opening Night) 
    • Play-by-Play: Matt Vasgersian (via Sports Business Journal
    • Color Analyst: CC Sabathia (via Sportscasting/Sporting News
    • Color Analyst: Hunter Pence
    • On-Field Reporter: Lauren Shehadi 
    Studio Team (Pregame/Postgame) 
    • Host: Elle Duncan (via Front Office Sports
    • Analyst: Barry Bonds (via Yahoo Sports
    • Analyst: Albert Pujols
    • Analyst: Anthony Rizzo
    • Special Guest: Bert Kreischer 
    The game is co-produced with MLB Network and is the first in a three-event package for 2026 that also includes the Home Run Derby in July and the Field of Dreams game in August.
